failureInterpretation.actualModelCheckNote: The report actualModelMatched check is false because a normal successful SDK receipt is absent; the partial receipt still reports claude-sonnet-5. No different actual model is inferred.

findings.evidence: Product finish completed, but the SDK partial receipt records 242070 input + 73 output = 242143 observed tokens against the unchanged 240000 budget. No SDK success may be inferred from saved product state.
findings.recommendation: Reduce redundant model-facing payload while retaining source and authority checks, and validate under the same budget. Do not fabricate completion, raise the budget or erase the failed trial.

boundedDesignAdvice.direction: Exact-current-state deduplication in the SDK-only contact result projection, leaving durable/full host results and all source text unchanged.
boundedDesignAdvice.candidate: First state, changed state and every error retain full current_state. Only an unchanged successful current_state may be omitted. Track the last state actually emitted, including full error states; reset per Run.
safetyChecks: A then A omits only the second identical successful state.
A then B retains B. A then error B then A must retain A; error emissions update the tracker.
Original messages, page bodies, source dates/references, selected IDs, non-state result fields and error recovery instructions remain unchanged.

SDK compaction or a fresh/resumed context must not inherit a tracker assumption that an earlier state remains visible; invalidate the tracker at that boundary or explicitly preserve this unresolved limitation.
Host source/lease/budget/permission checks still run on every tool. The SDK must reach its real terminal result; no stop-hook or fabricated completion is implied.

measurements.unit: Unicode JSON character counts, not provider tokens; overlapping counts are not additive savings

boundedDesignAdvice.limits: These counts expose avoidable payload, not an exact token/cost decomposition or a guarantee of completion. Keep the new grounding field descriptions; their semantic benefit should not be traded away for an assumed token saving.

limits: This is real Hao SDK with real product HTTP/PostgreSQL but controlled Exa-shaped synthetic responses, not a live Exa/TikHub end-to-end test.

Trial 3 cost and turn totals are unknown because usageComplete is false. Observed token counts are retained as lower bounds, not fabricated full accounting. Empty API retry receipts do not prove the number of network requests.
The field-description change is consistent with all three findings arrays being empty, but three samples cannot prove universal semantic grounding or establish causality.
The fourteenth batch remains quality 2/3 for its distinct chat-only source defect; every prior failed batch is preserved.

The SDK-only receipt prose is inspected separately from the saved product summary. Trial 1 uses an unsupported gender pronoun in that auxiliary prose; the saved records use the explicit name, and this review does not claim that auxiliary prose as the rendered product UI.
No screenshots, continuous client journey, manual user acceptance or overall GET-9 release acceptance are established by this artifact.
decision: Fifteenth remains execution 2/3 and independent quality 2/3. Trials 1/2 score 4/4/3/3; trial 3 scores 2/3/3/2 and fails the unchanged gate despite completed product filing.
